content.name: p
children: Each operator controller runs one reconcile at a time by default. This bounds memory, CPU, and database connection demand when many watched resources become ready at once, particularly during operator startup and watch resynchronization. The limit applies separately to the policy, ephemeral access policy, and ephemeral access request controllers; it is not a single shared global limit. Operators provisioned with more CPU can raise it to process independent databases in parallel.
